job._conditioning_note: The input file must be tab-separated with a header row. First column = SMILES; subsequent columns = property values. condition_dim must equal the number of property columns. Run experiments/conditional/compute_properties.py to create the TSV; it writes QED, SA_norm and LogP_norm by default, plus one column per --surrogate NAME=PATH. Add any such name to 'properties' here, in the same order, and raise condition_dim to match.
job._split_note: Random split is used here because the Butina split is already applied at the ChEMBL level. Using random here keeps the conditional dataset comparable to the unconditional ChEMBL split.
